Atrium Team Page

Source: R/atrium.R
atrium_team.Rd

A team page (summary tab): the team and its last and next game.

Endpoint: GET https://embed-api.eui.connect.sportradar.com/v1/embed/{website_id}/entity_detail

previous_* is the last played game and next_* the next scheduled one (NA when the page shows none). entity_id is decoded from the page's tab links; color is a hex string with its #.

Usage

atrium_team(
  website_id,
  entity_id,
  season = NULL,
  season_id = NULL,
  competition_id = NULL,
  locale = NULL
)

Arguments

website_id

(integer required): Site config id: which league site's widget this is (12 LNB France, 14 LNBP Mexico, 3 NBL1 Australia, 13 El Salvador, 22 Panama, 236 Austria, 326 Montenegro). Not a league id: one site serves several competitions.

entity_id

(character required): Team UUID (entity_id in atrium_teams() or any fixture row), e.g. "f43b1b0f-55bc-11f0-84d9-01499d2f0a07".

season

(integer optional): Season END year (2026 = 2025-26 on LNB, site 12, whose own year is the START year; the calendar year on the other sites). Needs competition_id when several competitions share that year (see atrium_seasons()). Omit season and season_id for the site's default season.

season_id

(character optional): Season UUID (season_id in atrium_seasons()); sent as is, skipping the END-year lookup of season.

competition_id

(character optional): Competition UUID (competition_id in atrium_seasons()). Picks the season together with season, and is then not sent; with neither season nor season_id the API filters by it.

locale

(character optional): Locale of the labels, e.g. "en-EN" or "fr-FR". Omitted = the site's own language. Ids and codes never change.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble, one row for the team:

col_nametypedescription
website_idintegerSite config id the body came from (12 LNB, 14 LNBP, 3 NBL1, 13 El Salvador, 22 Panama, 236 Austria, 326 Montenegro), read from the body's links.self.
entity_idcharacterTeam UUID, decoded from the page's tab links (the body does not echo it elsewhere).
namecharacterTeam name from the page banner.
colorcharacterTeam colour from the banner, hex string with its #.
logo_urlcharacterURL of the banner's team logo.
previous_fixture_idcharacterGame UUID of the last played game shown on the team page.
previous_roundcharacterRound of the last played game as the site words it (e.g. 30).
previous_statuscharacterStatus code of the last played game, e.g. CONFIRMED.
previous_start_time_utcPOSIXctStart of the last played game, naive UTC datetime.
previous_start_time_localcharacterStart of the last played game in venue-local time, as the API sends it (no offset).
previous_venuecharacterArena of the last played game.
previous_attendanceintegerSpectators at the last played game; null when not reported.
previous_home_entity_idcharacterTeam UUID of the last played game's home team.
previous_home_namecharacterName of the last played game's home team.
previous_home_scoreintegerHome team's points in the last played game.
previous_away_entity_idcharacterTeam UUID of the last played game's away team.
previous_away_namecharacterName of the last played game's away team.
previous_away_scoreintegerAway team's points in the last played game.
next_fixture_idcharacterGame UUID of the next scheduled game shown on the team page.
next_roundcharacterRound of the next scheduled game as the site words it (e.g. 30).
next_statuscharacterStatus code of the next scheduled game, e.g. CONFIRMED.
next_start_time_utcPOSIXctStart of the next scheduled game, naive UTC datetime.
next_start_time_localcharacterStart of the next scheduled game in venue-local time, as the API sends it (no offset).
next_venuecharacterArena of the next scheduled game.
next_attendanceintegerSpectators at the next scheduled game; null when not reported.
next_home_entity_idcharacterTeam UUID of the next scheduled game's home team.
next_home_namecharacterName of the next scheduled game's home team.
next_home_scoreintegerHome team's points in the next scheduled game.
next_away_entity_idcharacterTeam UUID of the next scheduled game's away team.
next_away_namecharacterName of the next scheduled game's away team.
next_away_scoreintegerAway team's points in the next scheduled game.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in atrium_fixtures().

 atrium_team(website_id = 12, entity_id = "f43b1b0f-55bc-11f0-84d9-01499d2f0a07")
